limitations: Held contrast sources were seen as original Train cases; 100% contrast scores are not independent-source model effectiveness or real organizational evidence.
Original retail exact loss covers only five unique periods crossed with seven generated conditions. Six new incomplete-period stops are excluded from that mean and must still count as a regression.
Only one training seed and two epochs were measured; no robust optimum or general superiority is established.
